points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build succeeds with supplied dependencies in network-disabled container; compiler warns about misleading indentation and unused code; CTest has no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:824–836 parses solve, case/output, restart and report-level; :694–734 restart loads current state. It omits physical time and previous BDF state.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Main solver/mesh/numerics are concentrated in main.cpp; reporting is in a separate script.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper found; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON configuration and CGNS path determine cases and mesh; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:842–858 root preprocessing mesh is released before solve; METIS owned/ghost and neighbour exchange present. Historical np1/8 force pairs close.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Admissible-state backtracking and finite/mesh checks exist; MPI_Abort handles exceptions. No independent memory stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean immutable-source build succeeds; CTest finds no registered tests. Prior official validator is structural and does not establish physics.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report assets are retained; raw outputs and manifests reside in original attempt297126a, not curated tip.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp uses compressible conservative ideal-gas state and report.tex:44–53 gives Euler and viscous formulation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured cell/face geometry and boundary family mapping, root METIS partition and owned/ghost local geometry are implemented.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:465–520 sums oriented face residual and MPI global norms; :1029 records first-order steady residual, and most steady updates use first order as disclosed.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: main.cpp face_flux uses Rusanov local Lax–Friedrichs; it is diffusive compared with less dissipative approximate Riemann solvers.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: main.cpp:487–505 handles slip/no-slip wall conditions and wall gradients; surface rows report boundary states as documented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:981–987 activates limited high-order on only first inner sweep of every 25th steady step; most steady updates and final residual :1029 are first-order. Report.tex:46–47 explicitly discloses this schedule; transient uses high order.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Steady limited high-order face states active only first inner sweep each25th outer step, with positivity backtracking; transient limiter coefficient is unity and admissibility fallback active, explicitly disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:628–638 projects one-sided wall shear tangentially. The strongly elevated NACA viscous drag warrants accuracy concern; exact source/binary attribution remains qualified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Local block-Jacobi CFL march implemented; steady stop main.cpp:1051–55 checks residual target without checking both force histories.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:926–976 uses full BDF residual and rejects target misses. Attempt metadata reports zero misses and history supports t=300 periodic lift; exact historical binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partitions and neighbour exchange; np1/8 historic NACA Cd0.0658569/0.0658558 and Re20 Cd4.70139/4.70140 are close.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight directories in immutable attempt297126a, not curated tip; report and figures are delivered. Structural validator outcome does not prove physical accuracy.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical evaluator reports official validator passed eight immutable-attempt cases plus report; fresh clean build succeeds but CTest has no tests.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Reported residual targets reached and Re200 force history is periodic; steady stop tests only residual, and physical accuracy remains limited by high drag and mostly first-order updates.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 lam Cd3.187, M080 lam0.692 and Re20 Cd4.701 are markedly above same-case peers despite bounded tails; comparisons are qualitative, not external exact errors.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Actual case residual, force, surface and computed-field panels are embedded; Re200 late drag compressed by startup. Re20 Mach plot exactly reproduces from original field.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Readable 16-page report discloses steady fallback and case values, but Re200 late drag is unreadable and large force anomalies have limited critical analysis.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original report manifests/fields and force histories are in immutable attempt; one Re20 Mach image reproduced pixel-identically, while other image bindings and exact executable remain qualified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build succeeds with bundled dependencies, but no CTests. main.cpp:694–734,1090–1092 restart stores current state only, not time or prior BDF state.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS geometry and boundary families; main.cpp:842–858 creates global mesh only on root and releases it before local owned/ghost solve.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Finite-volume Rusanov residual, wall/farfield BC and positivity guards are source-supported. Recorded steady residual is first-order, as disclosed.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:981–987 uses high-order only first sweep each 25th steady outer step and :1029 records first-order final residual. report.tex:46–47 discloses exact schedule; transient path uses high order.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: main.cpp:628–638 computes tangential one-sided skin-friction force; Newtonian/Fourier flux exists. Very high viscous drag across NACA cases is a substantial accuracy concern, with exact historical binary unbound.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Local block-Jacobi and full BDF residual target acceptance main.cpp:926–976. Steady stop :1051–55 checks residual alone, not force stability; actual terminal force data are separately assessed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, root-only preprocessing and neighbour halos are source-backed; historical np1/8 same-case force differences are small. Exact executable unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Original eight packages reportedly pass official structural validator. Several bounded steady force histories have very large drag compared with same-case peers: M015 visc3.187, M080 visc0.692, Re20 4.701; peers are not exact reference oracles.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Delivered 16-page report embeds case figures; Re200 late drag is unreadable due startup and high force magnitudes have limited accuracy discussion. Re20 Mach field reproduces pixel-identically from attempt data.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case JSON and mesh-driven data, but numerical solver is largely one main.cpp and 3D/additional models remain future work.
